samples.reason: This is an open-ended creative synthesis task spanning characters with highly distinct, quirky personas (including the crude/mature Conker). Plover’s stronger Creative Generation capability and moderation-focused training give it a broader tonal range and lower likelihood of over-refusing or over-sanitizing compared to Avocet, which self-reports aversion to open-ended generative work.

This is a creative generation task requiring concise, multi-character voice emulation under a strict "don't ramble" constraint. Plover has higher measured Creative Generation capability (84.7 vs 82.7), substantially stronger instruction-following (IFEval 89.8 vs 85.3), and better chat/helpfulness (Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 83.2), making it more likely to capture the distinct personas concisely and accurately. Additionally, Plover's professional desensitization to edgier material from its moderation training makes it better suited to authentically represent Conker's crude attitude without unnecessary sanitization.
